notes.title: Game Update
notes.content:
* The tutorial has been reworked to showcase the real gameplay as fast as possible.

* You can now adjust the game's difficulty prior to entering in a match against bots, allowing you to create a customized gaming experience.

Full patch notes can be found here:
https://imagindar.com/patch-notes/
